article1.title: Cash donation to several facilities for disabled people
article1.excerpt: Official handover of financial donations and support to several facilities dedicated to the care of people with disabilities.
article1.content: As part of our commitment to social inclusion and support for vulnerable populations, we have made an official handover of funds to three major reception centers. This financial assistance will make it possible to modernize their orthopedic equipment, ensure the renewal of educational materials, and finance the medical and assistance costs of the most destitute residents.

article2.title: In-kind and cash donations to nursing women
article2.excerpt: Distribution of food, basic necessity kits, and financial support for several nursing mothers and their infants.
article2.content: This solidarity campaign brought together volunteers and health professionals around single mothers and families in precarious situations. Over 120 kits consisting of infant hygiene products, baby formulas, diapers, basic food items, and direct aid envelopes were distributed.

article3.title: A look back at our big climate march in Abidjan
article3.excerpt: Hundreds of citizens marched alongside us to raise awareness among decision-makers about the urban climate emergency.
article3.content: A historic mobilization took place in the main arteries of the metropolis. Students, associative collectives, and families marched peacefully to carry a strong advocacy: acceleration of urban greening, better management of plastic waste sorting, and protection of lagoon banks.

banner.title: Contribute to one of these projects

project1.title: Distribution of school kits to destitute families
project1.description: Complete provision of bags, notebooks, pens, and educational manuals to relieve the financial burden of vulnerable parents and ensure the schooling of every child.

project2.title: Screening and prevention campaigns (Diabetes, Hypertension, Cancer, etc.)
project2.description: Deployment of mobile medical caravans crossing Ivorian towns and villages to offer free blood sugar tests, blood pressure checks, early screenings, and dietary advice.

project3.title: Reforestation campaign of several hectares
project3.description: Restoration of degraded ecosystems through community planting of shade trees, local forest species, and fruit trees, combined with biodiversity protection workshops.

project4.title: Development of play and leisure areas for children and adults
project4.description: Creation of secure relaxation areas including playful and motor skills modules for toddlers, shaded benches, and outdoor intergenerational socialization zones.

project5.title: Construction of a 6-classroom primary school
project5.description: Construction of an eco-designed school with 6 classrooms, an administrative block, separate hygienic latrines, and a canteen powered by solar photovoltaic panels.

project6.title: Construction of health centers in rural areas
project6.description: Creation of local dispensaries and rural maternities to ensure the management of obstetric emergencies, infant vaccination, and reduce medical evacuation times.

project7.title: Construction of a drinking water tower
project7.description: Deep water drilling coupled with an elevated tank and a network of public solar water fountains, to eradicate waterborne diseases and facilitate women's daily lives.

project8.title: Sports infrastructure in peri-urban villages
project8.description: Development of multisport platforms (7-a-side football, basketball, handball) equipped with locker rooms to encourage sports practice, strengthen social cohesion, and detect young talents.

project9.title: Multifunctional community digital center
project9.description: Technological third place including a park of fiber-connected computers, a coworking space, and certifying training in coding, office automation, and online administrative procedures.

3.content: Supporting Green Vision means investing in the future of Côte d'Ivoire. Their transparency and efficiency on the ground are exemplary. A trusted partner.

4.content: The impact of their awareness campaigns in schools is remarkable. Children are becoming true ambassadors of ecology at home.
4.author: Mr. Traoré
